title: Longest rivers
measure: Length in km from the most distant source to the mouth, following the longest chain of tributaries (so the Mississippi is measured from the Missouri's headwaters). All figures come from one source, Britannica, so they are measured the same way. River lengths depend on where the source and mouth are drawn, so most carry an uncertainty of a few per cent.

entries.name: Nile
entries.note: Guinness lists it as the longest. Some surveys that trace the Amazon from a more distant Peruvian source make the Amazon longer.

entries.name: Amazon
entries.note: Measured from the Ucayali–Apurímac source. The world's largest river by water flow, by far.

entries.name: Yangtze
entries.note: The longest river within a single country.

entries.name: Mississippi–Missouri
entries.note: Measured via the Red Rock source of the Missouri. Other sources give up to 6,275 km.

entries.name: Yenisey–Baikal–Selenga
entries.note: Flows through Lake Baikal into the Arctic Ocean.

entries.name: Congo
entries.country: DR Congo, Republic of the Congo, Angola

entries.name: Amur–Argun
entries.note: Forms much of the China–Russia border.
